run_dynamic_rnn: run dynamic_rnn to process variable-length sequences with a PyTorch RNN model using packed padded sequences
create_output_form_enum: create an OutputForm enum to specify whether dynamic_rnn returns all, last, or no RNN outputs
get_sorted_order: get_sorted_order to sort sequence lengths in descending order and compute forward and backward reorder indices
rearrange_tensors: rearrange input tensors along a given dimension using a reorder index tensor for batch permutation
test_dynamic_rnn: test dynamic_rnn with a GRU model on padded sequence inputs of varying lengths to verify correct output ordering
